title: Risk Stratification and Factors Associated with Heart Failure Hospitalization During Osimertinib Therapy.
snippet: Osimertinib is the standard of care for epidermal growth factor receptor mutation-positive non-small cell lung cancer, but heart failure hospitalization (HFH) remains a concern, and no practical tool exists to stratify HFH risk during therapy.
